descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
SUGAR RUNNER is a first-person platformer built for comfortable VR.

You are the size of a crumb, standing on a pancake at one end of an enormous laid table. The feast stretches away in front of you, floating high above a checked tablecloth, and the only way across is to run and jump.

TEN LEVELS, FIVE FEASTS
Breakfast, a sushi counter, a candy shop, the grill and a birthday party. Every two levels brings a new spread of food, a new tablecloth far below and a new sky.

A JUMP THAT FEELS GOOD IN VR
One long, soft arc every time, with no snap and no stomach drop. Walk with the left stick, snap turn with the right, jump with A. Nothing can hurt you: miss a landing and you simply hop back to the last checkpoint.

A KITCHEN FULL OF TRICKS
Frying pans and flying plates carry you across the long gaps. A coffee mug's steam lifts you up to a cheese wheel. Rolling pins sweep across the chopping boards, biscuits crack under your feet, and mushrooms waddle along the path.

CHERRIES AND GOLDEN DONUTS
Collect cherries, head-butt the milk cartons for more, and hunt down the golden donut in every level.

LONGER AND HARDER AS YOU GO
Level one is a gentle run across breakfast. By level ten you are running over half a kilometre, faster, over narrower platforms and longer gaps.

THE FINISH
Every level ends on a birthday cake. Hop up onto it, stand among the candles and the level is yours. The final level ends on a three-tier cake you have to climb.
